scripts.underlayer:gate: pnpm i && pnpm run underlayer:export && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build
scripts.underlayer:check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run build
scripts.underlayer:ready: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); const sh=(c)=>execSync(c,{stdio:'inherit'}); const out=(c)=>execSync(c,{stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe']}).toString().trim(); sh('pnpm run underlayer:gate'); const s=out('git status --porcelain'); if(s){ console.error('WORKTREE_DIRTY'); process.exit(1);} console.log('OK_READY_TO_TAG');"
